headline: Front Ledger Shifts as Contested Sectors Stir
war_summary: The latest returns show the front’s liveliest sectors changing complexion since the previous edition. Weathered Expanse has become the busiest watch, with 56 base events in 24 hours, five in the latest two, and holdings of three Warden, one Colonial, and five neutral bases. Nevish Line remains unsettled at 46 daily events and four in two hours; its ledger now shows two Warden and six Colonial bases, with none neutral. Linn Mercy has eased to 37 events, all quiet in the latest two hours, while retaining three Warden, seven Colonial, and one neutral position. Callahans Passage has quickened to 14 daily events and two in the latest watch, despite heavy casualty traffic, and is currently entirely Warden-held. Mooring County remains active at 19 events, though no fresh base movement appears in two hours; Marban Hollow likewise records 11 daily events without a recent change. Stonecradle and several outer sectors have gone comparatively quiet. The immediate contest is therefore concentrated chiefly in Weathered Expanse and Nevish Line, with Callahans Passage a secondary flare.
